feed.title: Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey
feed.subtitle: "The Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS) release presents data on job openings, hires, and separations. This release is issued monthly. For more information, visit the Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey home page at www.bls.gov/jlt/. "

entry.title: Job openings, hires, and total separations change little in July
entry.content: Job openings were little changed at 7.3 million in July. Hires and total separations were both little changed at 5.1 million.

entry.title: Job openings and total separations change little in June; hires unchanged
entry.content: Job openings and total separations were little changed at 7.4 million and 5.4 million, respectively, in June. Hires were unchanged at 5.3 million.

entry.title: May job openings and hires unchanged; total separations change little
entry.content: The numbers of job openings and hires were unchanged at 7.6 million and 5.2 million, respectively, in May. Total separations were little changed at 5.1 million.

entry.title: April job openings increase; hires and total separations decrease
entry.content: The number of job openings increased to 7.6 million in April. Hires and total separations decreased to 5.1 million and 5.0 million, respectively.

entry.title: March hires increase; job openings unchanged and total separations change little
entry.content: The number of hires increased to 5.6 million in March. Job openings were unchanged at 6.9 million while total separations changed little at 5.4 million.

entry.title: February hires decrease; job openings and total separations change little
entry.content: The number of hires decreased to 4.8 million in February. Job openings and total separations were both little changed at 6.9 million and 5.0 million, respectively.

entry.title: January job openings and total separations change little; hires unchanged
entry.content: The number of job openings was little changed at 6.9 million in January. Hires were unchanged at 5.3 million while total separations changed little at 5.1 million. Annual levels and rates for 2025 are now available.

entry.title: December job openings trend down, hires and total separations change little
entry.content: The number of job openings continued to trend down to 6.5 million in December. Hires and total separations were both little changed at 5.3 million.

entry.title: November job openings and hires change little; total separations unchanged
entry.content: The number of job openings was little changed at 7.1 million in November. Hires were little changed and total separations were unchanged at 5.1 million each.

entry.title: October job openings unchanged; hires and total separations change little
entry.content: The number of job openings was unchanged at 7.7 million in October. Hires and total separations were both little changed at 5.1 million.

entry.title: August job openings unchanged; hires and total separations change little
entry.content: The number of job openings was unchanged at 7.2 million in August. Hires and total separations were both little changed at 5.1 million.

entry.title: July job openings change little; hires and total separations unchanged
entry.content: The number of job openings was little changed at 7.2 million in July. Hires and total separations were both unchanged at 5.3 million.
